_meta.source: O*NET 职业数据库（U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration）
_meta.derived_from: O*NET Work Activities 与 Abilities 的 Importance 评分
_meta.ari_definition: 自动化可及性指数 = 常规侧 7 项工作活动均值 − 非常规侧 8 项均值。常规侧：Controlling Machines and Processes / Handling and Moving Objects / Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment / Performing General Physical Activities / Processing Information / Documenting, Recording, and Maintaining Information / Performing Administrative Activities。非常规侧：Thinking Creatively / Making Decisions and Solving Problems / Repairing and Maintaining Mechanical Equipment / Repairing and Maintaining Electronic Equipment / Inspecting Equipment, Structures, or Materials / Assisting and Caring for Others / Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others / Guiding, Directing, and Motivating Subordinates
_meta.pml_definition: 感知—操作负担 = Abilities 中 Psychomotor(10) + Physical(9) 的 Importance 均值
_meta.manual_definition: 常规手工分量（对应工业机器人等物理自动化）
_meta.routine_cog_definition: 常规认知分量（对应规则化业务系统）
